A hand enters the frame holding a small, brown fuzzy plush toy with a realistic human face printed on it. The background features white shelves filled with designer toy collectibles and glass bottles. (2) The scene cuts to the man sitting upright, gesturing towards a pink product box on the table titled 'Exciting Macaron' with Labubu illustrations. He speaks with an animated expression. (3) He picks up a silver foil mystery bag, tearing it open to reveal the same brown plush toy with the realistic face. He handles the toy, showing its back and front to the camera while laughing. (4) The man holds the toy up to a woman wearing a green and white long-sleeved shirt in a different room setting. She reacts with shock, covering her mouth and laughing, while another woman in the background also laughs and reacts with surprise.
